question: Do people who complain about pay actually intend to quit competitors, or are they negotiating?

plan.summary: Two constructs, one tuned judge each, run across the corpus, then a corrected crosstab of pay-grievance against quit-intent strength.

constructs.name: Pay grievance
constructs.definition: Whether the respondent treats compensation as a decisive grievance (not merely mentioned).

constructs.name: Quit-intent framing
constructs.definition: How the respondent frames their departure: negotiating (door open) < resigned < gone-for-good.

estimate.note: two judge passes over the corpus, Director compile included

analysis.note: exploratory ◌ until a gold sample exists; the plan includes a calibration prompt after the first run
